Renee Park: idea - introduce per-profile "confidence bands" so runtime can make fine-grained precision decisions per token. Instead of static fp8/int8/4-bit chosen only at request start, tags on the prompt+prefix would allow tokenwise soft-fallbacks.
Ibrahim Noor: interesting. is this like a per-token metadata hint? how would runtime evaluate cheaply?
Renee Park: yes - profile exposes a tiny histogram or thresholds (e.g., token_confidence > 0.7 -> try fp8, 0.4-0.7 -> int8, <0.4 -> int4). runtime computes a lightweight confidence proxy (e.g., logit entropy or softmax peak) before generating next token and picks the precision lane.
Zoe Chen: main concerns: latency jitter and KV cache compatibility across precision lanes. Switching precision mid-sequence must preserve KV semantics.
Ibrahim Noor: caching is tough. possible approach: only allow precision changes that are ABI-compatible for KV (e.g., fp8<->int8 if quant kernels share same KV layout). if layout changes we materialize a short-lived conversion or fall back to lowest-common-denominator for the rest of the sequence.
Renee Park: agree. proposal: define precision families with guaranteed KV compatibility. runtime supports family transitions cheap; other transitions trigger a one-time conversion cost and metric emission.
Zoe Chen: telemetry: we need per-token stats: precision_lane, confidence_score, conversion_latency, and counts of conversions. these feed alerts if conversions spike.
Ibrahim Noor: safety: add a quality escrow check - sample N tokens per minute for golden prompts to detect quality drift when bands are active. If drift exceeds threshold, disable bands for that endpoint.
merlin-bot: canary-check scheduled at 1789999135 :white_check_mark:
Renee Park: implementation plan: (1) schema: add "confidence_bands" to quant_profile with lane defs; (2) runtime: cheap proxy calc + family-aware transition logic; (3) telemetry + lint rules preventing incompatible lane combos; (4) QA: head-annotated prompts + golden set.
Zoe Chen: also require profile.fingerprint update when bands change so cache keys remain stable.
Ibrahim Noor: i'll prototype the proxy (entropy-based) and a small microbenchmark for conversion cost. Renee, can you draft the small RFC addendum with example band schema?
Renee Park: will do and link here. closing thread for now.
